outfits.title: Low-key Loadout
outfits.notes: A white tee, charcoal sashiko pants and clean white sneakers. Four actual products, with the optional slots left open.

outfits.title: Campus Courier
outfits.notes: Navy stripes and khaki cord make a relaxed collegiate set. The white tee is the under layer; the rugby is layer one.

outfits.title: Forest Sidequest
outfits.notes: Forest flannel under an olive wool overshirt, grounded with navy pants and brown boots. Remove layer two for milder weather.

outfits.title: After-hours Charcoal
outfits.notes: Port, faded black and charcoal with warm brown boots. Brass and amber are optional accents you can swap out.

outfits.title: Everyday Blue
outfits.notes: A blue Oxford and khaki deck pants with white leather sneakers. A straightforward set for testing cleaner shapes.

outfits.title: Corduroy Night
outfits.notes: Navy corduroy over a blue Oxford, with khaki pants and brown boots. The scarf, cuff and belt are optional slots, each linked to its exact product.
